choice_data_list: It's rare to see you sigh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oops, can't be like this! I gotta stay 
energetic and happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...That said, the body doesn't lie. I 
really might be more fatigued than usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you're not in good shape, your luck 
drops too! You've gotta get plenty of rest 
first to recharge your energy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Copano Rickey is feeling the 
fatigue building up. It might be best to 
reconsider our upcoming race schedule.
